title: Ongoing connectivity issues - 3 attempts at resolving
text: We had been using Rocket Money successfully for the last three years, and absolutely loved it. It successfully budgeted, helped us categorize and goal set. However, in early October, our bank was disconnected and required reconnection. This has happened from time to time. This time, transactions from that “reconnection” point on never came through. We contacted Rocket Money on three occasions as well as our bank to check on all possible issues. We were told to actively disconnect and reconnect. We did, and now ALL data is lot going back all the way. We are still unable to see any transactions. I’d love connecting with a human person by phone if possible. Each attempt, we are assured the app should work properly. Each time, it does not. It has been discouraging to lose so much data from an app we used regularly to monitor our financial health. I am still giving two stars in hopes it can be truly resolved, because when working properly, this app was a game changer for our finances.
